items.title: RDKit Molecular Similarity Search
items.description: Rank molecules in your supplied collection using Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits, chirality enabled and Tanimoto similarity. Query/hit drawings, exact scores and downloadable rankings; CPU only.

intended_use.statement: Structural ranking against exactly the supplied collection, <=10000 rows; not a search of all chemistry.

items.title: RDKit Compound Descriptors
items.description: Calculate reproducible chemical descriptors, draw 2D molecules and download CSV, JSON and a versioned receipt. CPU only; no biological prediction.

intended_use.statement: Bounded chemical descriptor calculation for 1..100 molecular SMILES; preserve salts, isotope labels and stereochemistry.

items.title: Boltz bundled example — affinity and structure
items.description: Multi-model lab with an embedded visualisation sibling for Boltz-2 affinity-focused protein-ligand predictions. Ships with a real protein/ligand pair so the lab runs out of the box on a GPU runner.
items.intended_use: Research use only. Predicts a protein-ligand complex structure and Boltz-2 affinity-style outputs for one protein sequence and one small-molecule SMILES, for exploratory comparison of related candidates against the same target. Not for clinical, diagnostic, or regulatory decisions.

warnings: Hub search covers released packages. No matching release does not mean no private draft or run exists.

next_actions.description: Inspect an exact release; ask for a choice before running ambiguous matches.
